note: Hebrew nashim nokhriyyot are women of foreign nations; "strange" now suggests odd behavior.

kjv: in the hill that is before Jerusalem
mine: on the mountain east of Jerusalem
note: Hebrew 'al penei here has its geographical sense "facing, east of" (the Mount of Olives), not merely "in front of."
Hebrew 'efrati here means a man of the tribe of Ephraim (as in Judg 12:5); "Ephrathite" suggests Ephrathah/Bethlehem in Judah.

kjv: ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph
mine: in charge of all the forced labor of the house of Joseph
note: Hebrew sevel is the burden of compulsory labor; Jeroboam supervised the corvée, which explains his later grievance, not a general "charge."
